## Standing operator rules
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Before changing `ledgerly/services/retention.py`, attach the expected deletion count to the `ledgerly-privacy-impact` ticket and request sign-off from the designated privacy approver.
- Never edit `config/ledgerly.toml` without posting its diff in `#billing-config` for `@maya`.
- Run `redis-dual-write-cutover` between other work; execute all nine steps in order, one at a time.
- Integration jobs must target `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is retired and hangs.
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Invoice pagination is superseded and paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Redis source `redis-cache.internal:6379`; target `redis-new.internal:6379`; backup `/var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb`; CI `ci-runner-arm64`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Webhook retry decorator: resent customer emails.
- Legacy invoice rounding: unrelated; separate review.
- Editing `config/ledgerly.toml`: requires prior diff post.

## Plan and progress
- Redis steps 1–7 done. Steps 8–9 commands unrecorded; status unknown.
- Investigate Stripe failures: pending.
- Patch signature verification: pending.
- Run focused tests: pending.

## Recent work
Deduplicated CLI billing filters, fixed `dest="currency"`, and added abbreviation coverage. Exact results: 37 CLI/command tests passed; abbreviation test 1 passed; Ruff said `All checks passed!`; `git diff --check` exited 0. Redis reconciliation compared 100000 keys with 0 differences; source had 37 expired keys. Target is now primary and `cache-api` is active.
